name: central-bank-rates-demo
description: Official exchange rates from 34 central banks — sample site using one npm SDK per bank (AllRatesToday API)

paragraphs: A sample static site that pulls the official published exchange-rate tables from 34 central banks — one npm package per bank — and renders them as a single self-contained dashboard. Built for developers evaluating the AllRatesToday Central Bank Rates API who want to see the per-bank SDKs actually working before writing any code.
These are the bank-published reference rates used for tax, customs, audit and compliant invoicing — not market ticks. Each response carries the bank's own publication date (ratedate).
features: 🏦 34 central banks, 34 npm packages — every card on the page is produced by a different SDK; the import is the demo
📦 Zero-dependency SDKs — each -exchange-rate package is a thin fetch wrapper over the API, no transitive deps
🗓️ Daily rebuild — a scheduled GitHub Actions workflow regenerates and redeploys the page every day at 06:30 UTC
🔒 Key never shipped — the API key is read from an Actions secret at build time and never appears in the repo or the published HTML
🪶 One static file — the build writes a single dist/index.html with inline CSS, dark-mode support and a client-side bank filter

requirements.text: The build needs an AllRatesToday API key in ALLRATESAPIKEY.
Every -exchange-rate package exposes the same four functions. options.apiKey is required on all of them.
Historical dates and time series (getRatesForDate, getHistory) need a paid plan.
